checks.name: cargo_xtask_ci
checks.command:
set -euo pipefail
source .project-tools/env.sh
ci_target="$(mktemp -d /workspace/.pr006-p2-ci-final.XXXXXX)"
printf 'Fresh CARGO_TARGET_DIR=%s\n' "$ci_target"

checks.name: review_p2_regressions_red_green
checks.red_observation: Both regression tests failed at the intended assertions: changed content rendered under the original manifest, and https:example.com/start was accepted for a CTA URL.
coverage: Mutating section text while reusing the original RenderManifest returns SectionContentHashMismatch.
Canonical content hash is stable across BTreeMap insertion order and changes for section IDs, variants, every field, optional markers, list lengths, and list order.
https:example.com/start and https:/example.com/start are rejected in CTA links and hero image URLs.
Existing HTTPS absolute URLs and same-worker root-relative /assets paths remain covered by passing tests.

scope_notes: The renderer owns a closed SectionContent enum and requires a BTreeMap entry for each revision section ID. Missing, unexpected, or mismatched content fails before HTML is returned.

RenderManifest::config_hash is the versioned content-sha256-v1 digest of sorted section IDs, typed variants, every UTF-8 field, optional markers, and ordered list lengths and entries, with explicit length prefixes.
Renderer::render validates the content and then recomputes the digest. Reusing a manifest with changed content returns SectionContentHashMismatch.

Section URLs accept explicit absolute https:// authorities or same-worker root-relative paths for /assets routes. https:example.com and https:/example.com, protocol-relative paths, unsafe schemes, malformed hosts, user information, controls, and unsafe percent escapes are rejected.

Lists are limited to C-01's 50 items. The checked 1 MiB renderer budget covers section IDs and content strings; storage/API still need the full serialized payload limit because serialization metadata and punctuation are outside this renderer check.
The test corpus includes 10,000 independent generated hostile text values and 10,000 generated hostile URLs. No Cloudflare deployment was run.
